sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, geometric-centre x/y in the deck-SVG coordinate space, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/msc/msc-world-europa/vlatest/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one element with class "cabin-shape" and a data-cabin attribute per stateroom (2297 <rect> + 23 <polygon>). Category legend built by matching each fill colour to an MSC World Europa stateroom category, verified per-colour against representative cabins on cruisedeckplans.com category-detail pages and cross-checked by exact category counts.

notes.completeness: PARTIAL grid. 2320 cabin shapes extracted from deckmaps across the 11 guest decks it publishes with staterooms (5,10,11,12,14,15,16,18,19,20,21); deckmaps also serves empty deck pages 6,7,8 (0 cabins). This total matches deckmaps' own advertised count (2320). MSC's real MSC World Europa capacity is ~2626-2633 cabins, so roughly 300 staterooms are NOT covered: deckmaps has NO deck plan for decks 9, 13 and 17, which carry (among others) all 46 Premium Balcony Aurea suites (deck 9) plus many Interior/Balcony/Ocean View/Grand-Suite cabins. Treat this file as a near-complete map of the decks deckmaps covers, not the whole ship.
notes.duplicateNumbers: 9 MSC Yacht Club duplex/whirlpool-duplex suites (16001,16003,16004,16005,16006,16008,16011,16013,16015) are two-deck suites and are drawn on BOTH deck 16 and deck 18 in the source, so they appear twice (once per deck) here. There are therefore 2320 cabin shapes but 2311 unique cabin numbers. This mirrors deckmaps' own per-deck counting.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 19 distinct fills map to 15 MSC categories (Balcony uses 3 green shades; Infinite Ocean View 2 blue shades; Studio 2 shades). Mapping verified with representative cabins from cruisedeckplans.com category-detail pages. Caveats: the fill #ef8227 covers BOTH Grand Suites and the 4 Whirlpool Bath Suites (they share one colour and cannot be split by colour alone); two Promenade View Suites (11288,11293) share the Family-Suite fill #f49f41; #9ac999 (252) slightly exceeds the published Promenade Balcony count (196), so a few of those may be standard balconies. See colorLegend.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. x is the length axis, y the beam. Bow direction detected from cabin numbering (lowest numbers 10001-10006 sit at maximum x), so forward = high-x third, aft = low-x third of the global cabin x-extent; mid = middle third. Consistent with the MSC Yacht Club (a forward complex on this ship) falling in the forward third. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Geometric split of the beam at mid-y: cabins above (low y) labelled port, below (high y) starboard. This matches the observed parity (odd numbers top/port, even numbers bottom/starboard) on a bow-to-the-right plan. Could be uniformly mirrored; validate against a known cabin before relying on it. Forward-facing and centreline inside cabins near mid-y are least reliable.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction; not asserted as clear-view).
